name: Hearth Herald
lore: An armadillo firekeeper from Ember Quarry carries the first coal of her village in a brass lantern. Her shell shelters travellers; her songs lend their weapons a little borrowed warmth.

primary.name: Lantern Light
primary.description: Hold primary to shine a forward lantern cone. Every 0.5s it deals 6 damage to enemies and heals other allies in the light for 1 HP. It never heals the caster. Walls block the light; release to stop.
primary.ui_brief: Held light • 12 damage/s • 2 allied healing/s • no self-heal

secondary.name: Kindle Arms
secondary.description: Enchant yourself and friendly heroes within 220 reach for 5 seconds: +8% attack damage. Direct hits apply burn for 2 damage per second for 3 seconds, at most once per target per second per attacker. Does not stack with another Kindle Arms.
secondary.ui_brief: Ally buff • +8% damage • attacks apply burn

special.name: Homefire Beacon
special.description: Plant a hearth banner at the aimed safe spot for 6 seconds. Allies within 180 reach heal 4 HP per second. The beacon catches up to 6 hostile projectiles entering its circle; friendly shots pass through. One beacon per caster.
special.ui_brief: Placed sanctuary • healing • catches 6 enemy shots

passive: Shared Hearth: you and friendly heroes within 170 reach gain 10% damage reduction while near the firekeeper. Multiple Shared Hearth auras do not stack; walls block the aura.

technique.name: Restorative Chorus
technique.description: Replace burning weapon enchantment with life-on-hit: retain +8% damage, but direct hits heal the attacker for 3 HP at most once per target per second. No added burn.

attack.name: Restorative Chorus
attack.description: Enchant nearby allies for 5s: +8% damage and 3 HP recovered on direct hits, once per target per second. Replaces added burning damage.
attack.ui_brief: Ally buff • +8% damage • life on hit

final_technique.name: Open Hearth
final_technique.description: Replace projectile catching with stronger healing: 7 HP per second for six seconds within the same banner circle. Enemy shots pass through.

attack.name: Open Hearth
attack.description: Place a banner for 6 seconds. Nearby allies recover 7 HP per second; it cannot catch projectiles.
attack.ui_brief: Placed sanctuary • stronger healing • no shot shield
